summary: The workspace-rooted `at` locus refusal is spelled twice — emit and the check judge — and the two now disagree on the `local` commitment class.

edit.description: The one home: a `workspace_rooted_locus_fault` predicate beside `local_locus_fault` (552) and `registration_locus_fault` (573) — the root-under-`.temper/` test plus the `Commitment::Local` exemption, decided once. Emit holds a `KindFactRow`, not a `CustomKind`, so either the home takes the lifted locus + class pair or a `CustomKind` method delegates to a row-friendly fn beside the existing `commitment_from_row` (831) / `content_from_row` (867) lifts — build picks, and names which in the commit body.

Emit's copy (1666-1680, raising `DriftError::AtLocusUnderWorkspace`, declared at 576) calls the one home. Today it tests the locus *before* its own `commitment_from_row(facts)? == Some(Commitment::Local) { continue }` at 1696, so emit refuses a payload member whose kind declares a local locus under the workspace while the judge spares it; the shared predicate's exemption closes that. Keep the variant's member-addressed sentence.

`at_locus_under_workspace_admissibility` (542) calls the one home instead of re-spelling the test at 562-563; its rule id `at-locus.under-workspace`, its re-rooting sentence, and its four unit tests (1069-1131, the relocated-built-in and local-`dial` cases included) stay.
The judge's one call site (335). No change expected — the judge keeps its signature; listed because the hoist reaches it if build changes that.

The divergence the fold closes, as a case: a `local`-locus kind rooted under the workspace with a payload member emits clean. The existing committed-class case (`an_at_locus_under_the_workspace_refuses_at_emit_and_check`, 563) stays green on both sides.

tests.asserts: emit accepts a payload member whose kind declares a `local` locus rooted under `.temper/` — matching the check judge's silence over the same locus — while a committed-class `at` locus under the workspace still refuses at both emit and check.

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the new local-locus emit case, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean, and `rg 'WORKSPACE_DIR' src/` showing one home for the `root == workspace || starts_with` locus test (import.rs's walk fence is discovery's own job, not this predicate).
